details:
Ever since the vrc update (oct 30 2024) I haven't been able to use the finger haptics that are a part of using the index knuckles controllers. I have never encountered this issue before, I have googled the crap out of this  issue and have yet to come to a solution as to fix it. Even conversated with friends on the issue whilst in game.

Legacy fingers doesn't do anything, I also checked in comfort and safety disabled the holotracking in there and re-enabled it back to 3 point tracked. I made sure finger tracking was enabled and even forced on in control settings. I also check the ik, didn't see anything to really change. I changed my controller parameters then set them back, I re-installed vrc, steam vr, ovr advance settings, nothing has remedied the issue, so I am at a loss as to why this is happening.

I know steamvr also had a update recently but I can see the finger tracking works fine in steamvr even made sure to check the controllers in the steamvr settings. All works fine, in other games, is fine. I haven't had this issue in the past ever.

As for my vr specs if one should know I am running a pimax 8k plus with index knuckles and 3 2.0 vive trackers.
title: Index Knuckles finger tracking not working
